# The O Spot by Chef Jun

> Bar kitchen serving Filipino pulutan, sizzling plates and beer. Established 2025. Prices in Philippine pesos (PHP).

## Visit

- Address: W Plaza Commercial, Sorsogon City ([Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place/W+Plaza+Commercial/@12.9922012,124.0224129,1058m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x33a0ef007dd5b9c7:0x67f7fab3412676c0!8m2!3d12.9922012!4d124.0249878!16s%2Fg%2F11ldqmd6lp))
- Hours: 12 noon to 12 midnight
- Phone: 0995 937 1753
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61582325510335

## Pages

- [Home](https://dhanmarlanortiz.github.io/theospot/)
- [W Plaza Beer Fest 2026](https://dhanmarlanortiz.github.io/theospot/beerfest-2026/): October 23–31, 2026, 4 PM to 12 midnight at W Plaza, Sorsogon City, with nightly live bands and contests. The O Spot serves a bucket of 5 beers for ₱390, beer at ₱85 a bottle and pulutan from ₱99.
- [Beer Fest 2026 Menu & Prices](https://dhanmarlanortiz.github.io/theospot/menu/)

## Menu

### Food
- Chicken Poppers: ₱99.00 (Bite-size crispy chicken with garlic mayo dip)
- French Fries: ₱99.00 (Ketchup or cheese sauce)
- Cheese Stick: ₱99.00 (Crisp-wrapped cheese rolls with ketchup)
- Lumpiang Shanghai: ₱129.00 (Pork spring rolls with sweet chili sauce)
- Hungarian Sausage: ₱129.00 (Grilled, served on a board with dip)
- Fried Chicken: ₱139.00 (Crunchy breaded fried chicken)
- Buffalo Wings: ₱139.00 (Saucy glazed wings with ranch dip)
- Lechon Kawali: ₱149.00 (Crispy deep-fried pork belly with spiced vinegar)
- Pork Sisig: ₱149.00 (On a hot plate, topped with egg and calamansi)
- Rice: ₱20.00 (One cup of steamed rice)

### Drinks
- Mix & Match Beer Bucket of 5: ₱390.00 (Any 5 bottles: San Miguel Light, San Miguel Flavored Beer (Apple), San Miguel Pale Pilsen, San Mig Super Dry, Red Horse)
- Beer per Bottle: ₱85.00 (San Miguel Pale Pilsen and other bucket choices)
- Softdrinks: ₱25.00 (Coke, Sprite or Royal)
- Mineral Water: ₱20.00 (Bottled water)
